artifacts.description: feat(io): swx-io crate with manifest.json and the canonical JSON writer

acceptance_criteria: New crate `crates/swx-io` (`publish = false`, workspace lints, MIT OR Apache-2.0). Its only dependencies are `serde` (feature `derive`) and `serde_json`. Each one, and every new transitive crate in `Cargo.lock`, gets a row with its license in the `ARCHITECTURE.md` dependency register, and the ADR log gets one appended line for the new crate. No other change to `ARCHITECTURE.md`.

A documented `Manifest` type with the fields of FILE_FORMAT.md's example: `format`, `format_version`, `kind` (an enum `Part | Assembly | Drawing`, written `"part"`, `"assembly"`, `"drawing"`), `document_id`, `units` (`length`, `angle`, `mass`), `created_by`, `saved_by`, and `model_hash` (`Option`). Unknown fields at the top level and inside `units` are kept and written back unchanged.

`pub fn read_manifest(json: &str) -> Result<Manifest, FormatError>` and `pub fn write_manifest(m: &Manifest) -> String`. `FormatError` is a documented enum that never panics, with at least a JSON-syntax variant, an invalid-field variant naming the field, and an unsupported-version variant.

Canonical writer, `pub fn to_canonical_json<T: Serialize>(v: &T) -> String`, documented: object keys in ascending byte order at every level, 2-space indent, one array element per line, UTF-8, and exactly one trailing `\n`. Tests: a golden file `crates/swx-io/tests/golden/manifest-v0.1.json`, written in canonical form from FILE_FORMAT.md's example (with a real 64-hex-digit `model_hash`), is reproduced byte for byte by `write_manifest(&read_manifest(golden)?)`; a manifest with an extra top-level field `"x_future": [1, 2]` and an extra `units.temperature` round-trips with both fields unchanged; keys given in a different order on input come out in canonical order.

Validation in `read_manifest`, each case with a test returning the right `FormatError` variant: `format` other than `"sltwx"`; `format_version` that isn't `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with decimal numbers; a major version other than 0 (unsupported); an unknown `kind`; a `document_id` that isn't a UUID in 8-4-4-4-12 hex form (either case accepted); a `model_hash` that isn't `sha256:` plus 64 lowercase hex digits; a missing required field; malformed JSON (`"{"`). A newer minor version (`0.2.0`) with an extra field is accepted.
`swx-io` has no `unsafe` and no workspace dependencies; `swx-core`, `swx-sketch` and `swx-kernel` are unchanged.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
constraints: Deviation: serde without the derive feature (derive pulls unicode-ident, Unicode-3.0, not on the allowed-license list).
